messages:
alex_support: Hey team — customer hit 401s after bundling our Node SDK with Rollup. They report Authorization header missing in the prod bundle. Ticket #7890.

toni_eng: Can you paste package.json + rollup.config? Also which SDK version?

alex_support: SDK v1.5.2. package.json:
```json
{
  "name": "app",
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
    }
  }
}
```

alex_support: rollup.config.js:
```js
export default {
  input: 'src/index.mjs',
  output: { file: 'dist/bundle.js', format: 'cjs' },
  external: ['node-fetch']
}
```

alex_support: Error from prod logs:
```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'headers')
    at sendRequest (/srv/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/cjs/http.js:45:23)
    at async createCompletion (/srv/app/index.js:12:5)
```

toni_eng: Hmm — bundling to CJS while the package.json uses conditional exports can cause deep-imports to pick the ESM build, then Rollup inlines/shakes certain wrappers. Could be our fetch wrapper getting flattened and losing header capture. Please get a minimal repro repo that demonstrates the 401 after build.

maia_devx: @toni_eng @alex_support I think this matches a previously reported bundler/exports edgecase where bundlers prefer the "import" path and remove the intermediate adapter. Filing an issue now. Please include a small repro (index.mjs + package.json + rollup.config). :eyes:

alex_support: Minimal repro steps I gave the customer:
1) git clone <redacted-minimal-repro>
2) npm i
3) npm run build
4) node dist/bundle.js
They see 401 only when running the built bundle.

alex_support: Workaround that fixed it locally: pin SDK to 1.4.1 (CJS-first) OR import the CJS entry directly:
```js
import SDK from '@redwood/sdk/dist/cjs/index.js'
```

toni_eng: Thanks — can you attach the raw server-side request headers showing Authorization present before bundling and missing after? That will help prove bundler stripped the header or inlined env.

alex_support: Attached from customer logs — pre-bundle request headers:
```
{ authorization: 'Bearer sk_live_XXXX' }
```
post-bundle:
```
{ }
```

sam_sre: Also confirm no ingress/sidecar is normalizing headers (Cloud Run sometimes drops unknown headers), but since local repro reproduces, looks like a bundler transformation.

build-bot: CI build passed for release v1.5.2 — repo tests don't cover bundler consumers.

maia_devx: Filed GH issue #1342 linking this thread. Assigning to @toni_eng. Customer-facing guidance: pin to 1.4.1 or import the CJS subpath until we ship a patch. We'll add a test matrix (Rollup, Webpack, esbuild) against conditional exports.

toni_eng: I'll try to reproduce with Rollup v2 + Node 18 + type: module. If I can reproduce I'll add an integration test and propose an exports fallback fix. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:

alex_support: Thanks — emailed the customer the workaround and asked for their minimal repro repo. I will post updates here when I get it.
